verdict.rationale: Security and compliance posture is a fair question to ask of a GPU cloud provider, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of SOC 2 attestations, data-handling policies, datacenter tier information, or a trust center. Single-tenant Private Cloud and workspace firewall rules are adjacent infrastructure features and do not let a buyer verify the provider's compliance posture.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify the provider's security and compliance posture (SOC 2, data handling, datacenter tiers) before putting proprietary models on it
